title: state/board.json — derived, overwritable, hybrid projection (rd/*.md + gate-records/*.json + heartbeats, plus telemetry/events.jsonl for what only the log can supply)
description: Written only by hooks/project-state.sh. Never hand-edited. Audit finding M5 (2026-07-29): earlier drafts of this title/description, and the plan's §7.1/§13 prose, claimed this file is 'rebuildable from telemetry/events.jsonl alone' — that was never actually true of hooks/project-state.sh (the real PostToolUse-wired projector), which reads rd/*.md frontmatter + gate-records/*.json + state/heartbeats/*.hb directly for state/module/summary/assigned_agent/leash/time-in-state, and only sums telemetry/events.jsonl for the one figure those direct-read sources can't supply (cost_usd, C8). Both source families are themselves auditable, versioned/append-only files, not opaque state, so this hybrid is a deliberate, honest design choice, not drift — but it is NOT a pure events-log replay, and /cz:rebuild-state's telemetry-only replay is a cross-check / recovery path against this hook's real output, not an equivalent alternate implementation of it. Stalls are NOT stored here as an event — board.html/​​​/cz:status compute them from last_heartbeat vs wall clock (plan §7.1).

counts.description: All eight mutually-exclusive RD states must sum to the total RD count (plan §7.2).

in_flight_detail.description: Optional convenience mirror of the in-flight subset of rds[] (denormalized for the header line). Not authoritative — rds[] is.

rds.description: One entry per RD, every RD in the project appears exactly once.

cost_usd.description: Rolled up by hooks/project-state.sh: sum of "cost_usd" across every telemetry/events.jsonl line tagged with this RD's id (C8). null means no cost-bearing event exists yet for this RD; 0/a number means at least one does.

leash.description: Mirrors the RD's own delegation.leash (rd.schema.json) — sourced by hooks/project-state.sh via cz_rd_field "$rd_path" delegation.leash. null only until risk-gov assigns delegation (phase 6); required and non-null on rd.schema.json once an RD is real (M6).

priority.description: Mirrors the RD's own priority (rd.schema.json), optional there. hooks/project-state.sh defaults to "medium" for any RD with no priority: field, so this is never null.

complexity.description: Display-only bucket of the RD's estimate.expected_h computed by hooks/project-state.sh (<=1.5h low, <=3h medium, >3h high) — not a stored RD field. null only if expected_h is unreadable.

finished_date.description: The gate_decision.timestamp from gate-records/<id>-gate.json — sourced by hooks/project-state.sh (same read already used for accepted-state time_in_state_s). null for any RD not yet accepted.

agents.description: One entry per live agent instance. last_heartbeat drives client-side stall detection — no stall event is ever written here.

phases.description: Project-level pipeline phases only (0 Scope, 1 Spec, 2 Modulemap, 3 Arch, 4 WBS, 5 Estimate, 6 Risk, 10 Report). Phases 7-9 (DoR/Build/Gate) run per-RD, not once per project, and are represented by rds[]/counts instead. Sourced from gate-records/PB<n>-*.json by hooks/project-state.sh.
